note: PriceGuide data for /projects/rainbow-tel-aviv/ (7.10.2026). Every number has its source here and in docs/research/2026-10-07-project-prices/README.md; the page shows dates only (no source names). Developer averages are the company's reported averages as the press quoted them (incl. VAT per Bizportal 6.6.2026). Rainbow sits in the official neighbourhood 'אזור שדה דב' (id 65210724), which has no published medians; the medians are of the adjacent official neighbourhood 'תכנית ל' (id 65210022). Tower max floor 39 (stage.js floors: 39; design plan: 39 above the entrance + a technical floor). calc.y0/y1 are for the chart once render.py passes them to the script (today the script falls back to 50,000-82,000).

sources.BZ2605: https://www.bizportal.co.il/realestates/news/article/20033020 (Bizportal 29.5.2026): Q1 2026 4 units for ~22M incl. VAT (~5.5M each), 85,669 ILS/m2; cumulative average to end of Q1 2026 81,782 ILS/m2 (81,704 to end 2025); 275 of 459 sold
sources.GL2608: https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001553606 (Globes 27.8.2026): Q2 2026 3 units at 80.5K ILS/m2, Q1 83.2K, 2025 85.6K (59 units), 2024 83.2K (99 units); after the report 5 more units at 82.2K; 275 of 459 sold
sources.BZ2606: https://www.bizportal.co.il/realestates/news/article/20033505 (Bizportal 6.6.2026): Sde Dov official prices ~75-85K ILS/m2; financing offers worth an implied 6%-8% discount; Rainbow Q1 2026 ~85.7K ILS/m2 incl. VAT
sources.GL2311: https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001463064 (Globes 29.11.2023, Tax Authority data): tower floor 4 of 39, 1 room 32 m2, 3.1M (7.2023); floor 6 of 39, 3 rooms 60 m2 no parking, 4M (mid 10.2023); floor 13 of 39, 3 rooms 98 m2, over 8M (end 9.2023); boutique floor 8 of 9, 6 rooms 182 m2, ~21.7M (9.2023) and 202 m2, 20M (3.2023)
sources.GL2407: https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001483864 (Globes 9.7.2024): several apartments on one of the tower's highest floors, ~50M, to be merged to ~550 m2, 'about 90K ILS/m2' (shell level)
sources.GL2410: https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-1001492500 (Globes English 28.10.2024): 134 m2 + 14 m2 balcony facing the sea, 14M, 'NIS 96,000 per square meter', a record in the project at the time
sources.GOVL: https://data.nadlan.gov.il/api/pages/neighborhood/buy/65210022.json (official medians, neighbourhood 'תכנית ל', Q1 2026, file 20.8.2026, read 7.10.2026): 3 rooms 5,346,100; 4 rooms 8,425,800; all 6,059,900; Tel Aviv: https://data.nadlan.gov.il/api/pages/settlement/buy/5000.json 3 rooms 4,225,800, 4 rooms 5,229,800
sources.ICE0305: https://www.ice.co.il/realestate/news/article/1111582 (ice 3.5.2026): Sde Dov 2025 ~1,280 units sold, average ~83K ILS/m2, 4 rooms average ~9.45M, range 60.2K (2 rooms 40 m2) to 138K (5 rooms 141 m2); March 2026 two deals 132 m2 5 rooms floor 9 at 7.157M and 7.565M; recent deals 104-126 m2 floors 10-13 at 6.487-7.727M
sources.ICE2105: https://www.ice.co.il/realestate/news/article/1112481 (ice 21.5.2026): most Sde Dov projects around 70K ILS/m2; a project east of Rainbow 60-62K; in Program L a new project's low floors 52-57K and most recent sales 70-72K
sources.TA: the site's Tel Aviv-Yafo card: Tax Authority deals 10.2023-10.2025, 2,432 deals, median 52,856 ILS/m2 (nlcp card on every Tel Aviv project page)

title: כמה עולה דירה בריינבו תל אביב
answer: דירה בריינבו תל אביב נמכרה בממוצע בכ-81,800 ₪ למ״ר, לפי דוחות היזם על כל הדירות שנמכרו עד 3.2026. בשמונה העסקאות האחרונות, ב-4 עד 8.2026, הממוצע היה 80,500-82,200 ₪ למ״ר, ועד 6.2026 נמכרו 275 מתוך 459 הדירות. בשכונה הסמוכה, תכנית ל, חציון העסקאות ברבעון הראשון של 2026 היה 5.35 מיליון ₪ לדירת 3 חדרים ו-8.43 מיליון ₪ לדירת 4 חדרים.
